name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
